## Active goal
Polish multi-conversation UX in the three ai_exec viewers (responses / chat_completions / messages). Keep ae.py untouched. Manage context via compaction skill.

## Multi-chat architecture (settled)
- list/create/select/rename/delete; default protected
- Active chat via .ae_active_input
- Parallel per-chat runners: _runners[chat_id] + .ae_runners/<transcript-filename>.pid
- start_process / stop_process / stop_all_processes; /api/send only blocks if THAT chat running
- Rename while running FORBIDDEN; PID keyed by transcript filename
- Per-chat drafts: localStorage ae-draft:<chatId>
- Env for children: AE_RUNNER=1, AE_INPUT_FILE, AE_CONVERSATION_ID

## Rail UX — current rules (just updated)
Density / layout:
- 0 chats: no side rail; floating '+' top-left over content
- 1 chat: no side rail; floating '+' top-left over content (chat tile not shown)
- 2–3 chats (wide): full list, no search
- 4+ chats (wide): list + search
- viewport ≤640px and ≥2 chats: left narrow rail with 36×36 square tiles (chat-item-tile first CJK/letter) + '+' below; contextmenu still works
- html classes: chat-solo-rail, chat-empty-rail, chat-rail-narrow; matchMedia resize hook re-renders

Solo/empty '+' styling (latest user request — done):
- Position: top-left (same as classic rail), NOT bottom-right
- No circular background / border / backdrop; transparent like original icon control
- Shadow only when '+' actually overlaps message content: class is-over-content + drop-shadow filters
- Detection: updateSoloPlusOverlap via elementsFromPoint on button center/corners; scheduleSoloPlusOverlap on scroll/resize/render/updateChatRailMode/renderChatList
- --chat-rail-space collapses to 16px so main content is full-width
